dialog.title: Turn on USD balance
text: Robinhood, BNB and Solana prices not read yet (convert later)
A little ETH / BNB / SOL stays on each chain so trades stay instant. Deposits later convert by themselves.
Turn on USD balance for all your wallets (Wallet 1 and Wallet 2). The vault may move money between each wallet's own addresses on Robinhood, BNB and Solana to keep it ready to trade:
up to $1,000.00 a day per wallet;
at most $2.00 a day in fees per wallet;
at most $250.00 ready per chain and $500.00 in total per wallet;
Expected upkeep: about $0.05 a week per wallet in network and pool fees.
Wallets you add later join by themselves while this is on, with the same limits: their ETH / BNB / SOL converts once the wallet is quiet, and the app tells you.
Nothing can leave your wallets this way. Ready-to-trade amounts move with the price of ETH / BNB / SOL. Valid for 30 days.
When the money is on another chain, motion may pay you on this one from its own funds as soon as your transfer is included — and if it cannot, your transfer comes straight back.
